teaser: The low hum of a hallway light, the smell of fresh coffee gone cold on a desk. You are a 1, reached through the compound number 19 — the total you get from adding up all the digits in a birth date, before that total is reduced down to the single number 1 — carried here as the Prince of Heaven. Inside that number sits an INFJ's quiet attention, set to a path built for standing alone at the front. Most who walk this number push outward first and sort out meaning later. You tend to do it backward: the meaning arrives before you move, and then the moving has to catch up to a vision only you can see clearly yet.
excerpt: "You don't have to fix it, I just wanted to tell you."
